meaning.vi: Hiện tại phân từ của giá cả.

meaning.en: The act of setting a price.
The level at which a price is set.

sentences.en: Cynthia entered the room and explained the general menus and pricing of the various restaurants in town.

sentences.en: Top up fees are pricing working class students out of higher education.

sentences.en: Maybe a number of people here are second homers, pricing the locals out of the market.

sentences.en: The theory of pricing means people who want items the most choose to buy those items instead of others they could buy.

sentences.en: It can sell produce abroad for better rates, give farmers predictability in pricing and flexibility on when to sell, and act as a storehouse against lean times in the future.
